memspec.memoryId: JEDEC HBM4 8.0 Gbps, 32Gb/die 8-High, one channel (2 pseudo channels)

sources.architecture: [J] Table 4: 32Gb 8H = 8 Gb/channel, 2 PC x 32 DQ, 256-bit prefetch (BL8), RA[13:0], CA[4:0] (32 bursts, 1 KB page), SID[0] + BA[3:0] = 32 banks/PC; Table 5: 8 banks per bank group = 4 BG/PC; dataRate 4 beats/CK (WDQS = 2x CK, DDR)
sources.CCDR: [J] Table 108 note 17: vendor value in tCCDS+1..tCCDS+2; minimum 3 used
sources.RTW: [J] Table 108 note 18: RU(((RL + BL/4 - WL + 0.5) tCK + tWDQS2DQ_O(max) 2.5 ns - tWDQS2DQ_I(min) 0.1 ns) / tCK)
sources.DQSCK: RU((tDQSS(max) 0.1 ns + tWDQS2DQ_O(max) 2.5 ns) / tCK), [J] Tables 107/108; used for tRDPDE and read data timing
sources.CKE: [J] Table 108: tPD = tCKSR = tCPDED + 6 tCK, tCPDED = max(10 tCK, 7.5 ns)
sources.RL/WL/RC/RAS/RCDRD/RCDWR/RRDL/RRDS/FAW/R: vendor-specific in [J] Table 108 ('-'); values from [RAM] (estimates there): RL 20, WL 10, RC 45 ns, RAS 28.5 ns, RCDRD 19.5 ns, RCDWR 9.5 ns, RRDL 3.5 ns, RRDS 2.5 ns, FAW 15 ns, RTP 6 ns, RP 16.5 ns, WR 21 ns, WTRL 6.5 ns, WTRS 4.5 ns
sources.RAAIMT/RAAMMT/RAADEC: 0 = refresh management not modeled (vendor DEVICE_ID values)
